  CHAR base

  IF c>='a AND c<='z THEN
    base='a
  ELSEIF c>='A AND c<='Z THEN
    base='A
  ELSE
    RETURN (c)
  FI
  c==+code-base
  c==MOD 26
RETURN (c+base)

PROC Encrypt(CHAR ARRAY in,out BYTE code)
  INT i

  out(0)=in(0)
  FOR i=1 TO in(0)
  DO
    out(i)=Shift(in(i),code)
  OD
RETURN

      ElseIf $move < 1 Then

  if (( $# < 3 )) || [[ "$1" != "-e" && "$1" != "-d" ]] || (( $2 < 1 || $2 > 25 )); then
    echo "Usage: ${FUNCNAME[0]} -e|-d rotation (1-25) argument[(s)...]" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  _func="${1}"; shift
  _rotval="${1}"; shift

  while [[ -n "${1}" ]]; do
    for (( i = 0; i < ${#1}; i++ )); do
      for (( x = 0; x < ${#_abc[*]}; x++ )); do
        case "${_func}" in
          "-e")
            [[ "${1:$i:1}" == "${_ABC[$x]}" ]] && _out+="${_ABC[(( ( x + _rotval ) % 26 ))]}" && break
            [[ "${1:$i:1}" == "${_abc[$x]}" ]] && _out+="${_abc[(( ( x + _rotval ) % 26 ))]}" && break;;
          "-d")
            [[ "${1:$i:1}" == "${_ABC[$x]}" ]] && _out+="${_ABC[(( ( x - _rotval ) % 26 ))]}" && break
            [[ "${1:$i:1}" == "${_abc[$x]}" ]] && _out+="${_abc[(( ( x - _rotval ) % 26 ))]}" && break;;
        esac
        # If char has not been found by now lets add it as is.
        (( x == ${#_abc[*]} - 1 )) && _out+="${1:$i:1}"
      done
    done
    _out+=" "
    shift
  done
  echo "${_out[*]}"
}

DEF FN Encrypt$(s$, key$)
    LET c$ = 0
    LET ret$ = ""

    FOR i$ = 1 TO LEN(s$)
        c$ = ASC(MID(s$, i$, 1))
        IF c$ >= 65 AND c$ <= 90 THEN
            c$ += key$
            IF c$ > 90 THEN c$ -= 26
        ELSEIF c$ >= 97 AND c$ <= 122 THEN
            c$ += key$
            IF c$ > 122 THEN c$ -= 26
        END IF

    NEXT

DEF FN Decrypt$(s$, key$)
    RETURN FN Encrypt$(s$, 26 - key$)

    {a, b} = Enum.split(org, key)

-export([main/2]).

rot(Char,Key) when (Char >= $A) and (Char =< $Z) or

  Offset = $A + Char band 32,
  N = Char - Offset,
  Offset + (N + Key) rem 26;
rot(Char, _Key) ->
  Char.

key(Key) when Key > 25 ->

  io:format("Cyphertext ---> ~s~n", [CypherText]),

! Shift each letter in text$ by shift% positions.  A–Z and a–z wrap
! within their own ranges; all other characters are copied unchanged.

routine caesar$(text$, shift%)
  declare string result$, ch$
  declare integer i%, code%

  result$ = ''
  for i% = 1 to len(text$)
    ch$   = mid$(text$, i%, 1)
    code% = ord(ch$)

    if code% >= 65 and code% <= 90 then
      ! Uppercase A–Z: rotate within 65–90
      result$ = result$ + chr$((code% - 65 + shift%) mod 26 + 65)
    elseif code% >= 97 and code% <= 122 then

      result$ = result$ + chr$((code% - 97 + shift%) mod 26 + 97)
    else
      ! Non-letter: pass through unchanged
      result$ = result$ + ch$
    end if
  next i%

sub criptex$(text$, key$, mode)
   local i, k, delta, longtext, longPattern, longkey, pattern$, res$

  cond:
    Character/isUpperCase(c):
      base =: int(\\A)
      char: base + mod(int(c).sub(base).add(k) 26)
    Character/isLowerCase(c):
      base =: int(\\a)
      char: base + mod(int(c).sub(base).add(k) 26)
